title: Enhancing the predictability of tooth movements with clear aligners—Part 2: Clinical strategies
html: Despite rapid advances in clear aligner therapy, the low predictability of aligner tooth movements remains a clinical challenge. This article (part 2) translates the conceptual biomechanical triad of anchorage, stress continuity, and aligner-tooth contact, along with the related determinant factors, described in part 1 into practical strategies to enhance the predictability of tooth movements with clear aligners. This paper features 3 interrelated strategic domains: patient-centered, aligner-mediated, and practitioner-directed strategies.
